prior: W-NCI06 original valid partial: four-hop 24/96, all successes confined to high-rehearsal family, 0/24 in three others; learned relevance scorer prioritized old/high-frequency edges. Avoid threshold variants; introduce genuinely different available-graph relation connectivity at native bounded-memory eviction.
hypothesis: Can 4-weight native SGD relevance scoring of local edge connectivity, exposure and relative age, considering incoming candidates as possible eviction victims, generalize withheld four-hop compositional queries better than frozen prior learned recency/exposure policy under same seven-edge budget?
architecture: Native W prior NCI06 learned admission (65 params) and learned join (6 params) unchanged; new four-weight logistic relevance policy trained solely on development future labels; at each overflow, feature computation uses at most eight public candidate edges (seven stored plus just observed incoming). Graph degree/adjacency feature is hand-coded but policy weights are learned. Reject incoming if it scores lowest; no external model and no sealed future-query labels.
fair_controls: Same seven stored edges, same twelve public admitted facts, same unchanged join. Frozen NCI06 learned three-weight policy, FIFO and LRU arms share same source stream; new policy can reject incoming unlike prior; report costs and control difference explicitly.
rubric: GRAPH_LOCAL_LEARNED_RETENTION_TRANSFER iff four-hop >=.60, >=.15 improvement over frozen NCI06 learned and >=.10 over LRU, with no family worse than NCI06 by >.20. PARTIAL_GRAPH_LOCAL_RETENTION_GAIN iff ≥.10 over previous learned without full guards. Otherwise NO_GRAPH_LOCAL_RETENTION_TRANSFER. Archive all 96 rows, family failures, resource multiplications, rejected incoming facts, checkpoint test. No NCI01 full claim even on positive.
controls: Development-only training and selection before one sealed first use
Original artifact before interpretation, full Go regression, independent read-only original trial audit
